findings.title: Non-EQL releases now run the Cargo.lock refresh and can commit unrelated lock churn
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The lock churn depends on a committed Cargo.lock already drifting from its manifests, which is a pre-existing tree state and not caused by this change; on an in-sync lock, `cargo update -p eql-bindings` at an unchanged version is a no-op.
